static_traits.name: Chen Zhiqing
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with family are strained due to focusing on study; there are supportive friends and family, but it is difficult to discuss with them feelings of guilt and self-criticism
static_traits.medical_history: without既往相似心理问题；without心理治疗史；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能够自我Reflection，频繁use“应该”句式，自我批评明显，略显紧张但配合度高

basic_info.main_problem: 因观看迪士尼电影等休闲活动而感到愧疚，进而产生Self-denial与自我批评，影响心理健康与Learning效率。
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks counseling to relieve the impact of guilt and self-criticism on mental health and productivity, thereby improving academic performance.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, school homework and extracurricular activity loads increased significantly; since then, whenever I try to relax or do leisure activities (such as watching Disney movies), strong guilt and self-criticism arise, making it hard to enjoy once-loved activities.
为更专注Learning而与家人疏离，Family relationships因此紧张，进一步加剧压力。

core_beliefs: I only have worth if I keep studying/working

special_situations.event: A few days ago, after completing part of the homework, watched a Disney movie and felt strong guilt midway
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not把时间全部用在Learning上，就说明我not够努力、很not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Formulates stricter study plans, compresses or stops leisure activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该Learning更多；我have not做够

special_situations.event: Whenever trying to relax or engage in any leisure activity
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Leisure equals wasting time; only studying counts as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过增加Learning时长来Undoing放松；negate休闲带来的积极Recovery
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Relaxing is a waste of time

special_situations.event: In recent months, school workload and extracurricular activity pressure have increased markedly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若学业表现not yet持续提升，就意味着我总是达not到期待
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticism and constant pressure to force oneself to improve efficiency
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，总是达not到期待

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在被认可与安全的前提下Freedom地享受休闲与自我照顾
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为not负责任、达not到期待，从而失去价值与成绩
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and guilt by internalizing external standards, maintaining harsh self-blame and high control

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的Student、总是达not到期待，需要时刻加压的自我
object_relations.object_representation: The judgmental critic demanding performance (school/others' expectations)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites giving meaning to the legitimacy of leisure or suggests increasing relaxation time
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者将外界的高期待Projection到咨询关系中，潜意识把“放松”等同于“not负责任”，担心会被评判为达not到期待
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和、支持性语气；先Empathy其愧疚，再邀请其具体化当前感受与身体反应；use开放式问题，Guidance将“应该”重述为“我选择/我偏好”；提供小步尝试的许可与明确界限，避免评判或过度Interpretation。

manifestations: 难以允许自己Freedom选择休闲，被“应该”与外界规则主导
将休息视为not负责任，难以体验自我选择的正当性
outcomes: Finds it hard to enjoy activities that used to bring pleasure

manifestations: 为专注学业而与家人疏离，Relationship tension
outcomes: Support utilization declines; emotional communication blocked

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该/必须……”的语句
Internalizes school pressure and external expectations as the only evaluation standard
Tends to make strict study plans to conform to internalized rules

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Reduces interaction with family for the sake of studying; turns pressure inward into self-reproach
When feeling tense, pressures oneself instead of seeking support

positive_force: Positive attitude; willing to seek help and cooperate with counseling
Willing to do self-observation and record thoughts (such as keeping a diary)
Has attempts and willingness for structured time management
negative_force: Distant from family; hard to express guilt and self-criticism
因内疚导致注意力与Decreased efficiency

target_behavior.behavior: Strong guilt and self-criticism appear when engaging in leisure activities
antecedent: Tries to relax or do leisure activities (such as watching Disney movies)
After completing part of the homework, still thinks one should keep studying
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的外部规则与“应该”信念，将休闲视为not负责任；Academic pressure增加trigger对效率的担忧
target_behavior.function: 逃避被视为not够努力的风险、维持自我价值感的控制
target_behavior.consequence: without法获得休息与愉悦，Low mood，Learning效率与专注下降

target_behavior.behavior: Isolating from family to focus on studying
antecedent: Feeling increased academic and activity loads
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕达not到期待，认为关系互动会妨碍Learning
target_behavior.function: Escapes external disturbances to maintain a sense of control and efficiency
